source_rows: Unreviewed agent draft. An operator review corrected four items: the +2.99% H1/H2 trend (unequal-period artifact, 181 vs 184 days; per day about +1.31%, below the POS seam, so the ordinary trend is indeterminate, not a reversal); the event dollar figure (an estimate versus one baseline, not proven and not full contribution margin); the Tier 4 label (actually Tier 3, no COGS); and post-send void 'loss' language (post-send voided menu value, not a loss). See case-study/CORRECTIONS.md.
